description: Search Pixabay's library of royalty-free photos and illustrations by keyword, image_type, category, orientation, colors, or order; returns URLs in multiple sizes, tags, likes, and download counts.

category.description: e.g. backgrounds, nature, science, education, people, animals, travel, business, music

colors.description: Comma-separated: grayscale, red, orange, yellow, green, turquoise, blue, lilac, pink, white, gray, black, brown, transparent

q.description: Search term, e.g. "red panda". THE subject of the request — omitting it returns Pixabay's generic popular feed, not a search result.

safesearch.description: "true" to restrict to images safe for all ages.

name: search_images

outputSchema.description: Response from Pixabay image search API

title: Search Images
